name: codex-antigravity-partner
description: Run governed Antigravity work with immutable review packets, permission-aware retries, ephemeral approval grants and separate Codex adjudication.

interface.longDescription: Runs bounded Antigravity headless tasks with explicit model selection, durable state and cancellation. Review mode binds work to immutable packet hashes, reports read-permission blocks, suppresses identical retries, requires single-use grants for unattended review and keeps Codex adjudication separate.
defaultPrompt: Delegate this bounded task to Antigravity
